_about: The words of the evidence figure (assets/src/evidence.ts). Every number in it is read from the checks' own results in evals/ when the figure is drawn: {braced} names are filled in there.
title: Checked against published figures
lead: Three checks against figures published by statistics offices and regulators. Each can be run again from this repository.

rows.head: The people match the census
rows.text: counts on nxk's made-up US adults within 2 points of 200,000 real adults in the Census Bureau's 2024 survey. The largest gap: {largest} points.

rows.head: The decision model knows who leans which way
rows.text: differences between groups in 22 official surveys put the right way round: {right} of {of}.

rows.head: Scans point the right way on real products
rows.text: differences in who uses 32 existing products, from social apps to premium bonds, put the right way round in nxk's own words: {right} of {of}.

key: Each square is 1 in 100 differences: in colour, the right way round.
note: The people are counted on your computer. Scans use Google's decision model on your own key.
